gcp.monitoring.read_time_series.note: Monitoring read API calls: per time series returned, at least one per call; calls from the console (not Cloud Shell) and write calls are free (https://cloud.google.com/stackdriver/pricing). Synced from the Billing Catalog. The price list's first tier is a free grant, billed here at the first paid tier's price.

gcp.monitoring.volume.note: Metric volume charged by bytes ingested. Volume tiers count the billing account's chargeable metric volume in a month, from 100,000 and 250,000 MiB (https://cloud.google.com/stackdriver/pricing). Synced from the Billing Catalog. The price list's first tier is a free grant, billed here at the first paid tier's price.
